verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's docs and marketing describe multiple AI-native capabilities — a hosted MCP server for natural-language querying of events/funnels/retention, AI-generated summaries of session replay trends, and auto-generated insight blurbs (e.g., 'Signups dipped 19%') — indicating genuine investment in AI-driven insights. However, all evidence is vendor-sourced (docs/marketing) with no independent community or hands-on validation of these specific AI features' quality or reliability.
